Definition: a prolonged form of G3165; me:--I, me, my(-self).
BiblicalUsage: In the New Testament, emé is the word for me, myself. It appears in Matthew and John, and each time it carries that same plain sense.
TheologicalSignificance: For me, emé means me, myself, and I leave it at that.
RelatedEvents: Jesus Sends Out the Twelve; Jesus and the Samaritan Woman
